message.content: Hey, I need you to draft the final invoice for the Van der Merwed wedding shoot. The client approved the extra hour, so please add that to the total.

content.text: I have the base quote ready. Adding the one-hour overtime rate now. The total comes to R45,000. Would you like me to set the payment terms to Net 15 or Net 30?

message.content: Net 15. And please attach the revised contract PDF to the email draft. I want to send it out before I head out to Cape Town.

content.text: Done. The email is drafted with the subject line 'Final Invoice & Revised Contract - Van der Merwed Wedding'. It includes the link to the PDF. Shall I schedule it for 8:00 AM tomorrow?

message.content: Yes, schedule it. Now, check the battery levels on my backup gear. I’m worried about the second camera body for the food shoot tomorrow.

content.text: I checked the Bluetooth logs from your gear bag. The primary body is at 90%, but the backup body is only at 40%. I recommend charging it overnight.

message.content: Thanks. Also, remind me to bring the 85mm lens for the portraits.

content.text: Added to your packing list: 85mm lens, backup body charger, and memory cards. Is there anything else for the food shoot?
